data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-r-z' meaning 'to free, to release'. This name symbolizes a spirit of independence and self-reliance, cherished in Islam as a sign of faith and obedience to God. data.spiritual_significance: The name Farizah carries deeper spiritual connotations, as it alludes to the concept of freedom from bondage to sin and obedience to God. In Islamic belief, Farizah represents the ideals of self-discipline, faith, and submission (Islam) to the divine will. It embodies the belief in striving towards acknowledged righteousness, and freeing oneself from the oppression of negative emotions and temptations. Ultimately, Farizah can be seen as a reminder of the importance of spiritual freedom, and the continuous struggle to uphold moral and ethical values in one's personal and communal life.
